scopeOutcomes.qualification: Edition overview and exact 8.8 matrices distinguish Essentials Cloud and Premier Cloud/Cloud Connected, license, regional exception and enablement. The Security AI Assistant is separate from standalone SAIA. A supported deployment alone does not qualify each regional feature. 8.8 aggregate lists both editions, Cloud Platform 10.1.x+ and CMP Platform 10.4.x+/ES 8.8+/Cloud Connect 2.0+. Linked 8.8 task also states ES 8.6+ in Cloud and requires finding-based detections off. Where the Cloud Connected setup is used, independently read SAIA 2.4 installer and retain license, network/certificate, fresh-setup and commercial-region conditions. Security AI Assistant enablement, response-template view/edit permissions and human review remain explicit.
